statement: A scorer that admitted only a plain success() in a workflow's if: conditions matched always(), cancelled() and failure() in the file's raw text, so if: "\x61lways()", which YAML decodes to always(), was credited as a check that stops the publish. A reader that admits a safe shape must test the value the platform will run, not the bytes before decoding. Rules: decode a scalar before matching it, or refuse on the credit path any escape or encoding the reader does not decode.
